{{Quote|Temp-flu does something to a man, sir. None of us want to die, either.|A pilot in the 37th Imperial Fighter Wing, to Lieutenant Soontir Fel|<ref name="X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25">[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron 25|''X-Wing Rogue Squadron'' 25]]</ref>}}
'''Temp-flu''' was a name that was given to a conditon whereby, near to the end of a [[Standard year/Legends|year]]-long tour of duty in a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] unit, a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] would hold back and put lives of other pilots at risk in an attempt to survive the entire year. In [[6 BBY/Legends|6 BBY]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lun Tessra]], the commander of the [[37th Imperial Fighter Wing]], suffered from temp-flu while fighting in the [[Reslian Purge]], against the forces of the [[Lortan]]s. As a result, Tessra's subordinate [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] assumed a leadership role within the unit, to compensate for Tessra's neglectfulness.
